enjoyment_reasons: The DeckSpec path carried a 12-slide business case with four split/complex layouts to deterministic_ready in 3 validates and 2 renders; every finding had a JSON-pointer path and a character budget, so each fix was one edit.
Previews (recommend_visual preview:true, list_slide_kinds preview:true) showed arch-stack rails and comparison rows before I authored them; S2 and S4 landed on the first attempt.

Two of the required shapes (roadmap with parallel tracks, before/after with connectors) were not expressible through their DeckSpec kinds and needed the raw_json2pptx escape hatch plus show_pattern reads.
plan_deck's deckspec draft was unusable for this brief (truncated title, 13 unplaced facts, 5 structural slides) and I threw it away.
--tools all cost 224 KB on first contact and 37 of 48 tools were never relevant; the one extra analysis tool I tried (analyze_deck_rhythm) returned an unlocatable recommendation.

findings.title: --tools all: 224 KB tools/list, 48 tools, 11 used
findings.what_happened: tools/list under --tools all returned 224,455 bytes for 48 tools. Across the whole journey I used 11 (get_started, plan_deck, list_slide_kinds, list_templates, recommend_visual, show_pattern, validate_deck_spec, render_deck_spec, render_deck_thumbnails, submit_visual_review, analyze_deck_rhythm). Settings-registry, cache, palette, export and raw-path repair tools were never relevant to a brief. show_pattern was the one extra I genuinely needed (to learn phase-roadmap parallel_tracks and comparison-2col connectors), and analyze_deck_rhythm (A12) did not help.
evidence: mcpd summary by_tool: 12 distinct tools incl. tools/list
findings.expected: First contact under 50 KB; extra tools grouped or deferred behind get_started so a brief-driven agent is not reading 37 irrelevant schemas.
findings.suggestion: Keep the default profile abridged and make show_pattern (or an equivalent 'pattern fields' view in list_slide_kinds compositions) available there, since it is the one extra the DeckSpec path actually needs for raw_json2pptx slides.

findings.title: plan_deck deckspec draft truncates the title and strands 13 facts
findings.what_happened: plan_deck(format: deckspec) took the brief's first sentence as the deck and cover title and truncated it to 'Steering-committee business case for Atlas Retail (EUR 3.1bn revenue, 640 sto...'. It routed architecture tiers to the executive_summary and option_matrix slots, planned no architecture, chart_insight, image_case or regions slide, spent 5 of 13 slides on cover/agenda/dividers, and listed 13 unplaced facts (all four after-KPIs, the cost split, the screenshot callouts, both parallel tracks). I discarded the plan and authored a flat 12-slide spec by hand.
evidence: call n=4: meta.title '…640 sto...'; unplaced_facts (13); budget.structural 5
findings.expected: A plan that recognises the brief's explicit slide requests (architecture, option matrix, TCO chart, roadmap, before/after KPIs, screenshot) and never ships a truncated title as a value.
findings.suggestion: Treat an ellipsised title as __FILL__; map facts to kinds by content type (tiers -> architecture, year series -> chart/regions, image -> image_case, phases + 'parallel' -> roadmap); count structural slides against the budget only when the brief asks for sections.

findings.title: roadmap kind cannot carry parallel tracks; phase-roadmap can
findings.what_happened: The brief requires a roadmap with two parallel tracks. list_slide_kinds item_schema for roadmap is additionalProperties:false with phases only; the composition it renders to (phase-roadmap) takes parallel_tracks[] and parallel_label, which I only learned from show_pattern. I had to author the slide as raw_json2pptx with the pattern block.
findings.expected: roadmap kind accepts parallel_tracks (or tracks) and passes them through.
findings.suggestion: Add parallel_tracks / parallel_label to the roadmap kind and mention it in the kind summary.

findings.title: No DeckSpec route to a row-aligned before/after with connectors
findings.what_happened: S4 needs four metrics today vs target aligned row by row with the improvement visible. The comparison kind allows only a pattern name as override, not overrides.connectors or highlight_column, and the before-after pattern is raw-only. I authored raw_json2pptx with comparison-2col {connectors:true, highlight_column:right}, which worked first time, but only after reading two show_pattern schemas.
evidence: call n=11: comparison item_schema has pattern:string only
findings.expected: A before_after kind (or comparison kind options like connectors:true / emphasise:'right') reachable without the raw escape hatch.
findings.suggestion: Expose the pattern's connectors and highlight_column through the comparison kind, or add a before_after kind with rows[{before, after}].

findings.title: regions table truncates 2 of 3 rows; fix text says 'split at row 1'
findings.what_happened: S1's right column held a stat (size_pct 45) over a 3-row, 2-column table (size_pct 55, with a heading). validate/render refused with FIT.table_rows_truncated '2 of 3 rows hidden … split the table at row 1' although the regions schema advertises up to 4 columns x 5 rows. There was no hint about which knob to turn; I guessed (stat 35 / table 65, drop the heading) and it passed.
findings.expected: A 3-row table in a 38%-wide, 55%-tall region fits, or the finding says the region is N% too short and suggests size_pct values.
findings.suggestion: Size the table region to its rows before splitting the side column, and make the fix name the size_pct or heading that would recover the rows.

findings.title: TEXT_BELOW_READABLE_MIN points at the slide, not the cell
findings.what_happened: On the raw phase-roadmap slide the error said 'card-title text renders at 9.5pt … shorten the text' at path /slides/8/slide, with no cell or value named. I shortened all three descriptions, all three milestones and both parallel tracks blind; it passed, so I still do not know which text was the culprit.
findings.expected: The path (or the first 30 chars of the offending text) of the cell that shrank.
findings.suggestion: Carry the pattern value path (e.g. values.phases[1].milestone) and the measured text in the finding.

findings.title: Blank table header silently dropped, then reported as a column mismatch
findings.what_happened: I gave the TCO table headers ['', 'EUR M'] (a label column without a title). The empty header was dropped and the error read 'row 1 spans 2 columns but headers define 1', which does not say why only one header survived.
findings.expected: Either keep an empty header cell or say 'header 0 is empty and was dropped'.
findings.suggestion: Allow empty header strings (common for a row-label column) or name the dropped header in the message.

findings.title: get_started says 'add compositions' but it is a fields value
findings.what_happened: get_started's list_slide_kinds step says 'add compositions when choosing a pattern/layout override'. Passing compositions:true was rejected with UNKNOWN_PARAMETER (accepted: fields, kinds, preview, template); it belongs in fields:[...]. The error was actionable, so it cost one call.
findings.expected: Guidance that matches the schema: fields:["compositions"].
findings.suggestion: Reword the step, and let the UNKNOWN_PARAMETER did_you_mean point at fields when the token is one of its enum values.

findings.title: recommend_visual ranking noise and 230 KB responses
findings.what_happened: For the architecture stack, gauge ranked #2 (0.9) beside arch-stack #1; for a four-way cost split, driver-tree ranked #1 although it needs 1-4 leaves per branch that the data does not have, with pie #3 and donut #4. Each call with preview:true was 224-242 KB with four preview images. I used the #1 for S2 (arch-stack) and the #4 (donut via chart_insight) for the cost driver.
evidence: call n=8: candidates arch-stack 1.0, gauge 0.9, pyramid 0.9 (224050 bytes)
call n=9: driver-tree 1.0, waterfall 0.92, pie 0.9, donut 0.82 (241813 bytes)
findings.expected: Candidates filtered by data shape (a share-of-whole list should not rank a decomposition tree first; a stack intent should not surface a gauge).
findings.suggestion: Parse numbers/percentages in the intent to gate chart families, and let preview take a count (preview_top: 2) to cut the bytes.

findings.title: image_case shows a 16:9 screenshot at a third of the slide with no width control
findings.what_happened: S3 rendered the ops console at roughly 33% of slide width with the lower half of the image column empty (fit contain in a tall column); the callout pills then covered a large share of the picture. The kind has no image width field; the underlying image-text-split pattern has image_width_pct 30-60 but no callouts, so widening the image means losing the callouts. The callout points themselves landed exactly where given.
evidence: call n=11: image_case item_schema (no width field)
findings.expected: A wide screenshot gets a wider column (or the text column yields when text is short), or the kind exposes image_width_pct.
findings.suggestion: Pass image_width_pct through image_case, or size the image column from the picture's aspect ratio when fit is contain.

findings.title: kpi_snapshot comparator floats detached below its card
findings.what_happened: With six KPIs, the comparator 'SLA is 6 am' on the third card rendered as a lone line far below the label row, visually orphaned from its card. I folded it into the label instead.
findings.expected: The comparator sits directly under the label.
findings.suggestion: Anchor the comparator to the label's bottom instead of the card's bottom in kpi-5up/6up.

findings.title: Sectioning nag on every call; analyze_deck_rhythm recommendation unlocatable
findings.what_happened: SEMANTIC_RHYTHM_SECTIONING warned on all three validates and all four renders that a 12-slide deck has no dividers; a 12-slide steering-committee case does not want dividers. analyze_deck_rhythm on the final deck gave composition_score 100 while recommending '100% of cells (2/2) are underfilled' at slide_index -1 and breaking patterns (kpi-3up, comparison-2col) the deck already uses.
findings.expected: Section advice only when the deck is long or the brief asked for chapters; rhythm recommendations that name a slide.
findings.suggestion: Raise the sectioning threshold (or respect meta.chrome without tracker), and drop deck-level recommendations that cannot cite a slide.

findings.title: Re-rendering a revised spec gives a new deck_id and 'all slides changed'
findings.what_happened: get_started promised that a re-render's next_tool_call carries known_hashes so only changed slides return an image. Sending the revised spec (v4) to render_deck_spec created a new deck_id, revision 1, changed_slides [0..11], and a next_tool_call without known_hashes; the full 12-image response (573 KB) came back although only two slides differed. The per-slide content_hash did let me verify which two.
evidence: call n=25: 573041 bytes; hashes differ only for index 2 and 3
findings.expected: Spec revisions are matched by slide id so the diff and the known_hashes shortcut work without the agent re-plumbing deck_id + patch.
findings.suggestion: When slide ids match a stored deck of the same title/template, reuse the deck_id and emit known_hashes for unchanged slides.

findings.title: pattern_overcrowded info for a 4-row comparison that renders fine
findings.what_happened: comparison-2col with headers and four rows (10 cells) reported GRID.pattern_overcrowded 'exceeds recommended max of 8 — consider splitting' on every run; the slide is airy with room for two more rows.
findings.expected: No advisory below the pattern's own 10-row maximum.
findings.suggestion: Use the pattern's row budget rather than a generic cell count.

findings.title: Slides scored 100 with a large empty band (KPI 6-up, image_case)
findings.what_happened: quality_summary scored slides 3 and 4 at 100 while slide 3's six cards occupy the top third with an empty band before the takeaway, and slide 4's image column is half empty (A10). Not wrong, but a reviewer notices and the score did not.
findings.expected: A layout-balance signal when a pattern uses well under half of the content area.
findings.suggestion: Report SLIDE_UNDERUSED (or a vertical fill percentage) for kpi-Nup and image-text-split when fill is low.
